text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes live. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality. Everyone writes cleaner code when they know a colleague will check it. In short, code reviews are not just about finding mistakes — they make the whole team stronger and the final product better.
